answer.description: The answer; a suspected defect is stated as a risk scenario saying what was not checked.

items.description: A line the agent actually read and cites as evidence.

side.description: head for the checked-out code; base only for removed code read from the base commit. `head`: Lines of the head commit. `base`: Lines of the base commit (removed code).

evidence.description: Lines read that support the answer.

description: An LLM answer to a question about a step.
